hero.body: Borrow £1,000 – £5,000 over up to 36 months. APR from 22.0% to 93.8%, personalised to your circumstances — and checking your eligibility won’t touch your credit score.
hero.fineprint: Applicants must be aged 21–71, earn at least £1,300 a month, and live in the UK.

quote.title: Your quick quote
quote.illustrativeNote: Illustrative, based on our representative 24.1% p.a. fixed rate — your personalised rate may differ.
quote.representativeExample: Representative example: on an assumed loan amount of £2,500 over a 24 month repayment period. Rate of interest 24.1% per annum (fixed). Representative 49.6% APR. Total amount payable is £3,705.12 of which £1,205.12 is interest, 24 monthly repayments of £154.38.

why.titleHtml:
The bank said no.
We look properly.
paragraphsHtml: Loans by MAL is a direct lender offering unsecured loans from £1,000 to £5,000, over terms of 9 to 36 months. We lend to a wide range of customers, using a combination of credit file and Open Banking data to make responsible and personalised lending decisions.
By using Open Banking technology, we can often help customers who are unable to borrow from banks and other lenders — we read the real picture, not just the score.

eligibility.title: Four quick checks before you apply

items.title: Age
items.body: Aged between 21 and 71 years old at the time of application.

items.title: UK residency
items.body: You live and work in the UK on a permanent basis.

items.title: Income
items.body: You earn at least £1,300 per month after tax — employment, self-employment or pensions.

items.title: Bank account
items.body: A UK bank account that supports Open Banking connections.

process.title: Easy as one, two, funded.
process.lede: Quick and easy application — with a fast in-principle decision.

items.title: Apply online
items.body: Choose your amount and term, tell us a little about yourself. The first two steps won’t impact your credit score.

items.title: We check affordability
items.body: Credit file plus Open Banking data — a responsible, personalised lending decision, not a tick-box one.

items.title: Sign. Funds land.
items.body: Sign, verify your banking, and after a quick 5–10 minute call we pay out — usually within hours.

review.quote: Very easy to deal with. Professional people who look after you. Very impressed — thank you for the outstanding service.
review.note: We encourage all customers to leave an honest review of their experience with Loans by MAL.
